states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $18.71 (+17.7%) consistently across the period.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is primarily driven by higher utilization (admission rate). Admits per 1,000 increased from 44.5 to 49.3, contributing $11.53 PMPM. Cost per admit contributed $7.17 PMPM.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: a. The change is concentrated in HMO (100% of change) product(s).
b. Key conditions: Malignant neoplasm, excl minor skin, w/o Surgery, with Active Mgmt (33% contribution, driving increase); Chronic Cardiovascular (25% contribution, driving increase).

c. Top DRGs by PMPM impact: DRG 003 - ECMO or Tracheostomy with Mechanical Ventilation > (PMPM impact: $8.05, MDC: No Major Diagnosis Category Code Assigne); DRG 007 - Lung Transplant (PMPM impact: $-2.75, MDC: No Major Diagnosis Category Code Assigne).
d. Additionally, DRG 268 - Aortic and Heart Assist Procedures Except Pulsatio (PMPM impact: $-2.52).

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated among:
- GRADY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL: PMPM impact $4.18, contribution 14.1%, unit cost increased 17% [high-cost facility, increasing unit cost].
- WELLSTAR MCG HEALTH MEDICAL CENTER: PMPM impact $3.67, contribution 10.2%, unit cost increased 244% [high-cost facility, increasing unit cost].
- EMORY UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL MIDTOWN: PMPM impact $3.10, contribution 9.6%.

additional_signals: New member mix changed by +0.6 percentage points, from 10.9% to 11.5%.
NPAR/IDR activity contributes 16.4% of the total cost change. IDR cases changed by +915, indicating network pricing pressure.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
